verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents a built-in official MCP server (glitchtip-docs-9) with a dedicated documentation page (glitchtip-docs-10, glitchtip-probe-4) that lets AI tools browse issues, inspect stack traces, and resolve issues without external data sharing. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of the MCP server working in practice, and more detail on setup/auth beyond the brief docs page.
